item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 14/Dec/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of replenishments of the northeast monsoon and a rainband, it will be cold over the coastal areas of Guangdong today and tomorrow. An intense winter monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China overnight on Friday. It will become further colder and windy over the region between the weekend and early next week. The weather will improve.

Date/Month: 14/12 (Wednesday)
Wind: North force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore at first.
Weather: Cold and cloudy to overcast with a few rain patches.
Temp range: 12 - 14 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
